Title: The Goblin Menace
Description: A band of goblins has been raiding nearby villages. Track them down and eliminate their leader.

Title: The Lost Artifact
Description: An ancient artifact has been discovered in the ruins of an old temple. Retrieve it before it falls into the wrong hands.

Title: Dragon's Lair
Description: A fearsome dragon has taken residence in the mountains, terrorizing the countryside. Only the bravest heroes dare face this challenge.

Title: Rescue Mission
Description: The mayor's daughter has been kidnapped by bandits. Rescue her and bring the bandits to justice.

Title: The Necromancer's Tower
Description: A dark necromancer is raising an army of undead. Infiltrate his tower and stop him before it's too late.

Title: Merchant Escort
Description: Escort a wealthy merchant through dangerous territory to the next town.

Title: The Cursed Forest
Description: Strange creatures have appeared in the forest. Investigate the source of the curse and lift it.

Title: Arena Champion
Description: Prove your worth by defeating all challengers in the grand arena tournament.

Title: Herb Gathering
Description: Collect rare herbs from the wilderness for the local alchemist.

Title: The Demon Portal
Description: A portal to the demon realm has opened. Close it before demons overrun the world.
